summary: This clinical trial compares the study drug tirzepatide against a placebo, which is an inactive substance, in adults who have type 1 diabetes and obesity or overweight. The study aims to look at changes in hemoglobin A1c, a measure of average blood sugar over time. Eli Lilly and Company is the sponsor for this Phase 3 study, which has an enrollment of 905 participants and a status of Active, not recruiting.
